description.value: Obanhmi is a sandwich shop on Kingsway, Vancouver's vibrant East Side arterial corridor, with a name that strongly suggests a Vietnamese bánh mì focus. Situated on a well-traveled cycling route connecting Burnaby to downtown Vancouver, it offers a convenient midpoint rest stop. The OSM record lists it as a sit-down restaurant with extended daily hours.
